messages:
emma.sales: NorthCo (POC) sent a long list: SOC2 excerpt, ISO network diagram, signed pen-test letter, external vulnerability scan, and importantly: SIEM ingestion for realtime logs + 90 day retention. They want all by Tue EOD. Any immediate blockers?

ryan.se: Quick clarifying Qs: Hosted or Dedicated POC? Also what log types do they want (request traces, model prompts, raw user content)? We need to avoid shipping PII.

nina.security: If they want prompt-level logs we need DPA approval & explicit retention rules. For telemetry (request ids, timestamps, non-sensitive metadata) we can forward. Any request for full payloads becomes a policy/legal review.

priya.legal: I can sign pen-test attestation once Security okays scope. If customer asks for a custom signature (CISO or legal sig blocks) expect 3 business days review. NDA changes add time.

emma.sales: POC is Dedicated (they asked for single-tenant). They insist on SIEM push (Splunk/QRadar) so they can monitor.

oliver.ops: Ops notes: we support two modes: 1) we push logs over TLS to their collector (syslog/tcp), or 2) they pull via secure S3 presigned archive. Mode 1 needs opening egress and firewall rules; Mode 2 is batch. Both require a short runbook.

ryan.se: For SIEM push we can map fields to a Redfield schema and strip PII. We'll need a signed DPA confirming allowed fields. Also call out KMS: is key customer-managed? If yes, we must provide KMS public key/thumbprint.

oliver.ops: Sample rsyslog snippet we recommend (sending to customer Splunk HTTP Event Collector via TLS):

```
# forward to customer's HEC endpoint
module(load="omhttp")
action(type="omhttp" server="https://splunk-northco.example:8088" bearerToken="<HEC_TOKEN>" tls.cacert="/etc/ssl/certs/ca.pem")
```

ops-bot: presign workflow available. Example for archive pull:

```bash
# request presigned download (ops API)
curl -X POST "https://ops-internal.redwood/api/presign" -d '{"path":"/evidence/northco/poc-logs.zip","expiry":3600}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN"
```

nina.security: Also: external vuln scan / pen-test letters we control: we provide template and will sign. If customer demands the scanner vendor's raw report, redact hostnames/ips for infra we share. Third-party red-team attestation is a different doc — ask which they want.

emma.sales: Pricing question from NorthCo: will SIEM forwarding be extra? They want it included in Dedicated quote.

oliver.ops: Bandwidth and storage: estimate additional ~200GB/mo + retention costs. Ballpark add-on $1,200/mo for egress/storage + one-time setup $750 for firewall rules & runbook. If they want full payload retention (prompts) add more.

priya.legal: Confirming: we should deliver SOC2 excerpt (control matrix), ISO network diagram (we have template), signed pen-test template, short ops runbook, and a statement of what log fields we will forward. I'll review once Nina approves field list.

ryan.se: I'll prepare the field map and a small sample JSON schema to show in the dataroom. ETA 24h.

nina.security: ETA for pen-test/signature if no NDA changes = 48h. DPA review might add 2-3 days.

emma.sales: Thanks. Callout blockers for customer call: 1) DPA status, 2) final pricing including SIEM addon, 3) signed pen-test letter. If any of those slip they may push start.

ops-bot: Firewall request ticket opened (#FW-4721). Ops will provide presigned archive within 4 hours. :gear:
